cards.en:
Internet of Things (IoT) refers to a network connecting different objects, such as home appliances, electronic devices, wearable technologies and vehicles. The connected objects share collected data and provide new functionalities. For example, vehicles send their speed and location to a server for real-time analysis of travel information such as estimated arrival time.

IoT commonly uses wireless technologies: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) and Near Field Communication (NFC). A smart speaker controlled by phone, a smart home with lights and air-conditioners controlled remotely, and smart bands are typical IoT devices.

IoT generates a huge amount of data every second. Powered by cloud computing, this data can be stored and processed through the Internet instantly, and the objects can then take actions automatically based on the processed data.
cards.zh:
物联网 IoT 是把不同物件（家电、电子设备、穿戴装置、车辆）连成网络。这些物件分享收集到的数据并提供新功能，例如车辆把速度和位置传到伺服器，作实时交通分析（如预计到达时间）。

常用无线技术：Wi-Fi、Bluetooth、RFID、NFC。例子：用手机控制的蓝牙喇叭、智能家居（遥控灯和冷气）、智能手环。

IoT 每秒产生大量数据，要靠 cloud computing 即时储存和处理，物件再按处理结果自动采取行动。考试常问：IoT 和 cloud 的关系 = IoT 收集数据，cloud 储存及分析。

ex.q: A smart air-conditioner turns on when the owner's phone is 1 km from home. Identify the IoT elements.
ex.a:
Object: air-conditioner and phone (connected objects).
Data collected: phone's GPS location.
Network: phone sends location via mobile data / Wi-Fi to a cloud server.
Processing: cloud checks distance < 1 km.
Action: server sends command to the air-conditioner to switch on.
ex.az: 物件：冷气机与手机；数据：手机位置；经网络送到云端；云端判断距离；然后指示冷气开机。

cards.en:
The cloud simply means the Internet. Everything in the cloud is stored in remote servers hosted by a third party and is accessible through the Internet. Users do not have to upgrade their hardware or install multiple pieces of software.

Benefits of cloud services:
  • Accessibility – data can be accessed anywhere and anytime via the Internet.
  • Flexibility – users can change their service plans on demand (e.g. buy more storage).
  • Maintenance – cloud service providers are responsible for maintenance, backup and upgrades.
Limitations to remember for exams: requires Internet connection; data is stored by a third party so there are privacy and security concerns; ongoing subscription fees.
cards.zh:
“云”就是 Internet。云端里的东西都存放在第三方托管的远端伺服器，经 Internet 存取，用户毋须升级硬件或安装多个软件。

好处：
  • Accessibility：随时随地经 Internet 存取
  • Flexibility：按需要更改服务计划（如加购空间）
  • Maintenance：维护、备份、升级由供应商负责
缺点（常考）：必须连网；数据由第三方保管，有私隐及保安风险；要持续付月费。

ex.q: A school stores homework in Google Drive instead of a local file server. Give two benefits and one drawback.
ex.a: Benefits: students access homework anytime anywhere (accessibility); the provider handles maintenance and backup so the school saves IT effort (maintenance). Drawback: no access without Internet / data held by a third party raises privacy concerns.
ex.az: 好处：随时随地存取；维护由供应商负责。坏处：断网不能用／数据交第三方有私隐风险。

cards.en:
Cloud computing provides a wide range of services over the Internet:
TypeWhat it doesExamples
Operating system (virtual machines)Run tasks on more powerful virtual machines in the cloudMicrosoft Azure, Google Compute Engine
StorageStore data in remote servers hosted by a third partyGoogle Drive, Microsoft OneDrive, Apple iCloud
Hosted applicationOpen and use a software application from the cloud server without installing itGoogle Docs Editors, Microsoft Office 365
Cloud computing also powers collaboration tools: users can share and co-edit files in real time.
cards.zh:
云端运算三类：
Operating system / virtual machines：在云端更强的虚拟机运行工作（Azure、Google Compute Engine）。
Storage：把数据存于第三方伺服器（Google Drive、OneDrive、iCloud）。
Hosted application：直接在云端开启使用软件，不用安装（Google Docs、Office 365）。
云端亦支援协作工具：多人实时共同编辑文件。

ex.q: Classify: (i) training an AI model on a rented powerful server; (ii) backing up photos to iCloud; (iii) writing an essay in Google Docs.
ex.a: (i) Operating system / virtual machine service. (ii) Storage. (iii) Hosted application.
ex.az: (i) 虚拟机；(ii) 储存；(iii) 托管应用程式。

cards.en:
Students working on a group project could (1) pass a USB drive around, (2) meet after school while one person types, or (3) use cloud-based document editing such as Google Docs.

Cloud collaboration is better because members can edit the same document simultaneously in real time, from anywhere; there is only one up-to-date version (no version conflicts); changes are saved automatically with version history; and comments allow feedback. The USB method is slow, only one person edits at a time and files may be lost or infected by malware. Meeting in person needs everyone in the same place at the same time.
cards.zh:
小组项目方法：(1) USB 轮流传；(2) 放学见面由一人打字；(3) 用 Google Docs 等云端文件。
云端较好：多人同时实时编辑、随地可用；只有一个最新版本，无版本混乱；自动储存并有版本纪录；可留言回馈。USB 慢、一次只一人改、可能遗失或中毒；见面则要同时同地。

ex.q: Give two disadvantages of circulating a USB drive for a group project compared with cloud collaboration.
ex.a: Only one member can edit at a time, so it is slow; different copies cause version inconsistency (or the USB may be lost / spread malware).
ex.az: 一次只能一人修改，慢；多个副本导致版本不一致（或 USB 遗失／传播病毒）。

cards.en:
Cloud-based IoT applications have enabled the development of smart cities. A smart city is a complex system of systems: interconnected systems use data collected by IoT and take actions based on AI analysis. It aims to make better decisions and improve quality of life by addressing urbanisation challenges such as environmental sustainability, traffic congestion and waste management.

Hong Kong's Smart City Blueprint covers six areas: Smart Economy, Smart Living, Smart Mobility, Smart Environment, Smart People and Smart Government.
cards.zh:
云端 IoT 应用推动智慧城市。智慧城市是“系统中的系统”：互相连接的系统用 IoT 收集的数据，按 AI 分析采取行动，目的是改善决策和生活质素，应对城市化问题（环境、交通挤塞、废物管理）。
香港六大范畴：Smart Economy、Living、Mobility、Environment、People、Government。

ex.q: Explain how a smart traffic light system is an example of a smart city application.
ex.a: Sensors/detectors (IoT) count vehicles and pedestrians at junctions; data is sent to the cloud; AI adjusts green-light time in real time (real-time adaptive traffic signal); this reduces congestion – Smart Mobility.
ex.az: 侦测器收集车流人流→送云端→AI 实时调整绿灯时间→减少挤塞，属 Smart Mobility。

cards.t: Smart Economy: online banking and payment
cards.tz: 智慧经济：网上银行与支付
cards.en:
With the growth of Internet and mobile devices, e-banking and digital payments are popular.
  • Online banking lets customers check up-to-date transactions without waiting for the monthly statement, transfer money and pay bills 24/7.
  • Online payment platforms such as PayPal, FPS (Faster Payment System) and PPS let users settle payments over the Internet; users can top up digital wallets or link them to credit cards/bank accounts. This boosted online companies and start-ups.
  • Contactless payment: rechargeable smart cards (NFC, e.g. Octopus), credit/debit cards (magnetic stripe, chip, NFC), mobile wallets (NFC, QR code).
A shop accepting only electronic payment may lose customers who prefer cash and may widen the digital divide.
cards.zh:
互联网和手机普及，网上银行和电子支付流行：
  • Online banking：随时查看最新交易、转账、缴费，毋须等月结单
  • Online payment（PayPal、转数快 FPS、PPS）：可增值 digital wallet 或连信用卡／银行户口，推动网店发展
  • Contactless payment：八达通（NFC）、信用卡、手机钱包（NFC、QR code）
只收电子支付：失去用现金的顾客，扩大数码鸿沟。

ex.q: A restaurant installs a ticket machine accepting only credit cards and mobile payment. Give one advantage and one disadvantage.
ex.a: Advantage: faster and contactless payment, no need to handle cash/change, fewer staff. Disadvantage: customers who prefer cash (e.g. elderly) cannot pay, limiting sales and widening the digital divide.
ex.az: 好处：快、免找续、省人手。坏处：只用现金的顾客无法付款，影响生意并扩大数码鸿沟。

cards.en:
Instant messaging, video conferencing, cloud collaboration and remote logon have changed business operations and facilitated Small Office/Home Office (SOHO). Employees can access company files and collaborate through the Internet, so working in the office is no longer a must.
ProsCons
EmployersCheaper rent and operating costs for a smaller office; hire talent anywhereRisk of data breaches due to insecure connections outside the office; harder to supervise
EmployeesSave commuting time; flexible hoursExtra costs for workstation and Internet; blurred work-life boundary; less social interaction
cards.zh:
即时通讯、视像会议、云端协作、远程登入让 SOHO 和在家工作成为可能。
雇主：好处是租金及营运成本低；坏处是办公室外连线不安全，可能数据外泄、难监督。
员工：好处是省交通时间、时间弹性；坏处是要自付电脑和上网费用、工作生活界线模糊、少社交。

ex.q: State one advantage to an employer and one disadvantage to an employee of working from home.
ex.a: Employer: lower rent/operating cost. Employee: extra cost of setting up a computer and Internet at home (or blurred work-life boundary).
ex.az: 雇主：租金低；员工：要自付设备及上网费用。

cards.t: Smart living, government, mobility, people, environment
cards.tz: 智慧生活、政府、交通、教育、环境
cards.en:
Smart Living / Government: HA Go app (hospital appointments, medical records), My Library app (renew/reserve books), iAM Smart – one digital identity to log in to government online services, form filling and digital signing.
Smart Mobility: Free-flow Tolling System (pay tunnel tolls automatically without stopping), new parking meters (real-time vacancy, online payment), real-time arrival information of public transport, real-time adaptive traffic signals based on detected vehicle and pedestrian flows.
Smart People (education): remote learning via video conferencing, online/multimedia resources, real-time evaluation that marks automatically.
Smart Environment: street lights adapting to movement, fill-level sensors to plan bin-collection routes, monitoring electricity use, water quality and air pollution remotely.
cards.zh:
生活／政府：HA Go、My Library、智方便 iAM Smart（一个数码身份登入政府服务、填表、数码签署）。
交通：不停车缴费系统、新一代停车咪表（实时空位、网上付款）、实时到站资讯、实时交通灯调节。
教育：遥距学习、网上多媒体资源、自动批改。
环境：智能街灯、垃圾桶满载感应器规划收集路线、遥距监测电力、水质、空气。

ex.q: A library installs self-service kiosks connected to a server. Suggest three Internet services they can provide.
ex.a: Book searching (database access); updating the availability of books (database update); storing users' borrowing records (data storage); calculating overdue fines (computation). Any three.
ex.az: 搜书（查数据库）、更新书本状态、储存借阅纪录、计算逾期罚款。

cards.en:
Email (electronic mail) refers to messages sent through the Internet. It remains an effective means of communication in the workplace. Unlike instant messaging apps, email is a cross-platform communication method: users can access their mailbox with any browser or app on a computer or mobile device, and send email to anyone regardless of the email service provider (e.g. Gmail to Outlook).

An email address has 3 parts: username + @ + domain name of the mail server, e.g. tom@school.edu.hk. The username indicates the owner of the mailbox, which may be an individual, a mailing list, an organisation or a role (e.g. info@).

Advantages over instant messaging: more formal, cross-platform, can carry larger attachments, keeps a searchable record, recipients need no specific app.
cards.zh:
Email 是经 Internet 传送的讯息，职场仍常用。与 IM 不同，email 跨平台：任何浏览器或 app 都能存取，不论服务供应商都能互相收发（Gmail ↔ Outlook）。
地址三部分：username + @ + domain name，如 tom@school.edu.hk；username 可代表个人、邮寄清单、机构或职位（info@）。
比 IM 好：较正式、跨平台、可附较大文件、易于保存和搜寻纪录、收件人不用装指定 app。

ex.q: Identify the parts of mary.chan@abcss.edu.hk.
ex.a: Username: mary.chan; @ symbol; domain name: abcss.edu.hk (identifies the mail server/organisation).
ex.az: username = mary.chan；@；domain = abcss.edu.hk。

cards.en:
There are three recipients' fields that function differently and protect personal data at different levels.
FieldFeatureApplication
ToThe original email; addresses appear in the headerMain recipients who must take action or pay attention
Cc (Carbon copy)Addresses appear in the received message header; other recipients know a copy was sentSend a copy for information only
Bcc (Blind carbon copy)The header hides these addresses; other recipients do NOT knowSend a copy without others knowing; best practice for bulk mail to protect recipients' privacy
What each person sees: To/Cc recipients see the To and Cc lists. A Bcc recipient sees the To and Cc lists plus their own address – never other Bcc addresses.
cards.zh:
三个收件人栏保护个人资料程度不同：
To：主要收件人，需要采取行动。
Cc：副本，只供参考；地址显示在 header，其他人知道。
Bcc：密件副本，地址被隐藏，其他人不知道；大量发信（bulk mail）的最佳做法，保护收件人私隐。
谁看到什么：To／Cc 收件人看到 To 和 Cc 名单；Bcc 收件人看到 To、Cc 及自己，看不到其他 Bcc。

ex.q: Janice emails To: Patrick, Cc: George, Bcc: Mrs Lee. (a) What does Janice expect from Patrick? (b) Do Patrick and George know Mrs Lee got a copy?
ex.a: (a) Patrick should take action (e.g. review the attached agenda); George receives it for information only. (b) No – Mrs Lee is in Bcc, so her address is hidden from the header.
ex.az: (a) Patrick 要跟进；George 只供参考。(b) 不知道，因 Mrs Lee 在 Bcc。

cards.en:
Three basic actions on a received message:
  • Reply – responds only to the original sender.
  • Reply All – responds to the sender and all recipients in the To and Cc fields. Bcc recipients are not included, because their addresses were hidden.
  • Forward – sends the message to new recipients. Attachments are forwarded by default unless removed. The forwarded message shows only the To and Cc recipients, so Bcc recipients are NOT disclosed.
Email history is included automatically. A Bcc recipient will not receive later replies: pro – avoids unnecessary emails in a long thread; con – the Bcc recipient is excluded from the future conversation. Note: if a Bcc recipient clicks Reply All, others will discover they received it.
cards.zh:
三个动作：
Reply：只回原寄件人。
Reply All：回寄件人及所有 To、Cc 收件人；Bcc 不包括在内。
Forward：转给新收件人，附件预设一并转寄；转寄内容只显示 To/Cc，Bcc 不会曝光。
Bcc 收件人收不到之后的回覆：好处是避免长串讨论的多余邮件；坏处是被排除于讨论之外。注意：Bcc 收件人若按 Reply All，其他人就会知道他收过信。

ex.q: Janice (sender) emails To: Patrick; Cc: George; Bcc: Mrs Lee. Patrick clicks Reply All. Who receives it?
ex.a: Reply All goes to the sender plus To and Cc recipients except the replier himself: Janice and George. Mrs Lee (Bcc) does not receive it.
ex.az: Janice 和 George；Mrs Lee 在 Bcc 不会收到。

cards.en:
Three ways to send files through email:
MethodFeaturesSuitable for
AttachmentThe file is sent with the message and takes up storage space in the mailbox; limited by email size limit (e.g. 25 MB)Small files such as text documents
Inline embeddingThe file is shown in the message body; most clients only support images; some clients disallow automatic image loadingImages, e.g. posters
HyperlinkMuch larger size limit; file stored in cloud storage/hosting site, so it does not take up mailbox spaceLarge files such as videos; websites
Hyperlink pros: smaller email, less mailbox storage, less data transferred. Cons: the link may become invalid if the provider removes the file; recipients may need permission/Internet to open it.
cards.zh:
三种方法：
Attachment 附件：随邮件传送，占邮箱空间，受大小限制；适合小文件。
Inline embedding 内置：直接显示于内文，多数只支援图片；有些 client 不自动载入图片。
Hyperlink 超连结：文件放云端，限制大得多、不占邮箱空间；适合影片等大文件。
连结的缺点：文件被删除后连结失效；可能要权限或网络才能开启。

ex.q: Why does sending a poster via an image-hosting link take less mailbox space than attaching it?
ex.a: With a link, the image is stored on the hosting site; the email only contains the URL (a few bytes), so the email size increases very little. An attachment embeds the whole file in the email.
ex.az: 连结只含网址，图片存在寄存网站；附件则把整个文件放进邮件。

cards.en:
Most spam and junk mail can be detected and blocked by the email service provider with the help of Artificial Intelligence (AI), but some spam still reaches the inbox and some valid emails are wrongly put in the spam folder.
  • Mark as spam / not spam to improve the accuracy of spam detection.
  • Use a whitelist (safe senders) so their emails are never classified as spam, and a blacklist to block unwanted senders.
  • Some clients do not automatically show images from untrusted senders: spammers can calculate the open rate by counting image downloads (confirming your address is active), and images may carry malware.
cards.zh:
大部分垃圾邮件由供应商以 AI 侦测及阻挡，但仍有漏网，也有正常邮件被误判。
  • 按 mark as spam / not spam 提高准确度
  • Whitelist（安全寄件人）与 blacklist（封锁寄件人）
  • 不自动显示陌生寄件人的图片：spammer 可借图片被下载计算 open rate（确认地址有效），图片也可能藏恶意程式

ex.q: Why might an email client ask 'Display images below?' for an email from an unknown sender?
ex.a: Loading remote images tells the sender the email was opened (open rate tracking, confirming the address is active for more spam) and the image could be malicious, so the client blocks it until the user trusts the sender.
ex.az: 载入图片会让寄件人知道你开了信（计 open rate），也可能有恶意内容，所以先封锁。

cards.en:
Remote logon, also known as remote access, is the method to remotely access a device from another device. It allows authorised users to connect to, or even control, a device from a geographical distance (e.g. IT support fixing your computer, accessing your school computer from home).

Remote desktop software (e.g. AnyDesk, Chrome Remote Desktop, Microsoft Remote Desktop) is the most popular solution and is usually cross-platform. A secure remote desktop program should provide authentication, VPN and encryption.

Requirement: the same remote desktop software must run on both computers, the host must be on and connected to the Internet. In Chrome Remote Desktop, the host sets a PIN of 6+ digits; for remote support a one-time access code valid for 5 minutes is generated and the host must approve sharing.
cards.zh:
远程登入（remote access）= 用一部设备远距离存取另一部设备，授权用户可连接甚至控制它（IT 支援、在家用学校电脑）。
最常用 remote desktop software（AnyDesk、Chrome Remote Desktop），通常跨平台。安全的软件应有 authentication、VPN、encryption。
条件：两部电脑运行相同远程桌面软件，主机要开着并连网。Chrome Remote Desktop：主机设 6 位以上 PIN；远程支援用5 分钟有效的一次性存取码，并需主机批准。

ex.q: John wants to use the school's 3D modelling software from home. What setup is necessary?
ex.a: The same remote desktop software must be installed and running on both the school computer and John's home computer; the school computer must be switched on and connected to the Internet; John must authenticate (e.g. PIN).
ex.az: 两部电脑都要运行相同远程桌面软件，学校电脑开着连网，John 需认证。

cards.t: Benefits and limitations of remote logon
cards.tz: 远程登入的好处与限制
cards.en:
Benefits:
  • Use software that is licensed to a specific computer without paying an extra subscription.
  • Run a resource-intensive program on a more powerful computer (e.g. better GPU).
  • Access files stored on other computers anytime and anywhere; access resources only available to the school's IP address.
  • IT teams can give remote support.
Limitations:
  • A data breach may occur during data transmission over the Internet.
  • Performance depends on network: high latency if either side has a poor Internet connection or runs out of RAM.
  • The remote computer must stay on.
Security measures: data transmission encryption; two-factor authentication or one-time password.
cards.zh:
好处：用只授权给某部电脑的软件、在更强的电脑上运行重型程式、随时存取他机文件或只限学校 IP 的资源、IT 远程支援。
限制：传输中可能数据外泄；任何一方网络差或 RAM 不足会高延迟；远端电脑必须开机。
保安：加密传输、双重认证／一次性密码。

ex.q: A user experiences high latency during a remote session. Suggest one cause and one security measure the software should have.
ex.a: Cause: poor Internet connection / low bandwidth on either side, or one computer running out of RAM. Security: encrypt the data transmitted, or use 2FA/one-time password to verify the user.
ex.az: 原因：网络差或 RAM 不足。保安：加密传输或 2FA。

cards.en:
Online chat enables private conversation with an individual or a group of people using different types of multimedia such as text, audio, images and videos, plus emoticons and stickers. It lets people communicate anytime and anywhere through the Internet and has become part of everyday life.

Forms:
  • Direct messages on social networking sites.
  • Instant messaging apps (WhatsApp, Signal, WeChat) with voice and video calls.
  • Online messaging service for customers to seek help from customer service or online sellers.
Compared with email: chat is real-time and informal, but usually requires the same app on both sides (not cross-platform) and compresses media.
cards.zh:
网上聊天让人与个人或群组私下对话，可用文字、语音、图片、影片、表情和贴图，随时随地沟通。
形式：社交网站的私讯；即时通讯 app（WhatsApp、微信，含语音／视像通话）；客服网上讯息。
与 email 比：即时、随意，但双方通常要用同一 app（不跨平台），并会压缩媒体。

ex.q: Give one advantage of email over instant messaging for sending a job application.
ex.a: Email is cross-platform (the employer needs no specific app), more formal, supports larger attachments without compression, and keeps a record that is easy to search.
ex.az: Email 跨平台、正式、附件不被压缩、易保存纪录。

cards.en:
Discussion forums (message boards) are online platforms where people can ask and answer questions or share content related to a certain topic. Examples: Reddit, Quora, Stack Exchange (users upvote useful answers), Uwants, Baby Kingdom. Forum features in learning management platforms increase interaction in online teaching.

Social Networking Sites (SNS), also known as social media sites, enable people to stay connected by sharing experiences and ideas in digital media (text, images, audio, video). They help users keep in touch with friends and build relationships with people who share similar interests. Blogs evolved from online diaries.

Risks of SNS: overexposed personal information, fake news, phishing, cyberbullying.
cards.zh:
讨论区：按主题发问、回答、分享（Reddit、Quora、Stack Exchange、Uwants），学习平台的讨论区可增加网上教学互动。
社交网站 SNS：以文字、图片、影音分享经验和想法、保持联系，并结识兴趣相近的人；Blog 由网上日记演变。
风险：个人资料过度曝光、假消息、钓鱼、网络欺凌。

ex.q: Why might a student post a programming question on Stack Exchange rather than social media?
ex.a: A forum is organised by topic, so people with expertise in that subject answer; good answers are upvoted, making reliable answers easy to find; the Q&A is searchable for others later.
ex.az: 论坛按主题，有专门人士回答，好答案被 upvote，之后可搜寻。

cards.en:
Three major factors when choosing a file transfer method: file size, file format and security.
MethodFile formatsSize limitEncryption
Instant messagingAutomatic image and video compressionSmallUsually end-to-end encrypted
EmailNo restrictionsSmallOnly when both providers support encryption
Cloud storageNo restrictionsLargeSome support it; relatively low
Network drive over VPNNo restrictionsNo limit if enough storageYes
Peer-to-peer file sharingNo restrictionsNo limit if enough storageNo
cards.zh:
选择传输方法看三点：文件大小、格式、保安。
IM：自动压缩图片影片、限制小、通常端对端加密。Email：不限格式、限制小、双方供应商支援才加密。云端：不限格式、限制大、保安较低。VPN 网络硬碟：无限制、有加密。P2P：无限制、不加密。

ex.q: A friend sent a holiday vlog by instant messaging, but the quality is low. Why, and what should be used instead?
ex.a: IM apps automatically compress videos to reduce data usage, so quality drops. Share a cloud storage link (or network drive) which keeps the original file and supports large sizes.
ex.az: IM 会自动压缩影片；改用云端连结保留原画质。

cards.en:
After recognising the information you need, you can locate it on websites, social media, forums or most simply with a search engine. Search engines are widely used for searching information on the World Wide Web (Google, Yahoo!, Bing). When a user enters a keyword, the search engine's program looks up its index of crawled web pages and ranks the matching pages. Results differ among engines, but the fundamentals are the same.

Search Engine Optimisation (SEO) is the process of improving website traffic by increasing the rankings and visibility in search results. It is important in digital marketing because billions of searches happen daily and users rarely look beyond the first page. Note: top results are not necessarily the most reliable – some are ads or SEO-optimised.
cards.zh:
找资讯可用网站、社交媒体、论坛，最简单是搜寻引擎（Google、Bing）。输入关键字后，程式在已收录网页的索引中找出相关网页并排序。
SEO = 提高网站在搜寻结果的排名与能见度，从而增加流量，对数码营销很重要。注意：排前的结果不一定最可靠，可能是广告或做了 SEO。

ex.q: A bakery's website appears on page 5 of Google results. Suggest what it should do and why.
ex.a: Carry out SEO (e.g. relevant keywords, good content, fast loading, links from other sites) to raise ranking, because most users only click results on the first page, so higher ranking brings more traffic/customers.
ex.az: 做 SEO 提高排名，因为用户多只看第一页。

cards.en:
Apart from search engines, users can look for information in databases (e.g. online journal and newspaper databases subscribed by schools and libraries).
Search engineDatabase
Content can change anytimePublished content that does not change
Contributed by any Internet userEvaluated for accuracy by publishers
Usually freeOften requires subscription/login
Huge range, mixed qualityFocused, organised (author, date, subject)
Databases are a more reliable source for academic research. Advantages of digital libraries/databases over traditional libraries: access anywhere and anytime, faster searching with keywords; both can be reliable.
cards.zh:
除搜寻引擎外，还可用数据库（学校／图书馆订阅的期刊、报章数据库）。
搜寻引擎：内容随时改变、任何人都可贡献、多免费、质素参差。
数据库：已出版内容不变、经出版者审核准确性、通常要订阅。
学术研究用数据库较可靠。数码图书馆好处：随时随地存取、搜寻更快。

ex.q: A student writing a Biology project chooses between Google results and the school's journal database. Recommend one and explain.
ex.a: The journal database: its content is published and evaluated for accuracy by publishers, so it is more reliable/credible for academic work, whereas search results can be written by anyone and change anytime.
ex.az: 选数据库：内容经出版者审核，较可靠。

cards.en:
Four steps: choose keywords → choose source types → use Boolean logic → refine your search.
  • Keywords: a concept can be expressed in different words; try synonyms or related keywords. More specific keywords give fewer, more relevant results.
  • Source types: filter by All, Images, Videos, News, Books. Filters: Images – size, colour, type, publish date, usage rights (e.g. Creative Commons); Videos – duration, publish date, quality, closed captions, source.
  • Boolean logic: operators to include/exclude terms (see next card).
  • Refine: use tools such as time range, region, site; review and modify keywords.
Private-search engines (e.g. DuckDuckGo) don't track users, but your browser can still link data to accounts.
cards.zh:
四步：选关键字 → 选来源类型 → 用 Boolean 逻辑 → 收窄搜寻。
  • 关键字：试同义词／相关词；字愈具体结果愈少愈准
  • 来源类型：图片、影片、新闻；过滤器如尺寸、颜色、发布日期、使用权限（Creative Commons）、片长、字幕
  • Boolean 运算子：包括／排除字词
  • 收窄：时间范围、地区、网站

ex.q: Eva needs a free-to-use photo of a red panda for her poster. Describe how to search.
ex.a: Use the keyword 'red panda', choose the Images source type, apply the usage-rights filter (Creative Commons licences) and maybe size filter for large images; then check the licence on the source page.
ex.az: 关键字 red panda → 选图片 → 使用权限筛选 Creative Commons → 到原网页确认授权。

cards.en:
TechniqueOperatorExample
Exclude particular resultsPut “-” in front of the keyword to excludeapple -fruit
Combine keywords (either)Put “OR” between search termsmandarin orange OR tangerine
Exact matchPut a phrase inside quotation marks """artificial intelligence"
Specific website or domainPut “site:” in front of a website/domainsite:gov.hk
Operators can be combined: "smart city" site:gov.hk -tender. OR widens results (more); "", -, site: narrow results (fewer).
cards.zh:
-：排除（apple -fruit）。OR：任一字词（mandarin orange OR tangerine），结果变多。""：完全相符的词组。site:：只搜指定网站或域名（site:gov.hk）。
可组合："smart city" site:gov.hk -tender。""、-、site: 会令结果变少。

ex.q: Write a query to find pages about Apple the company's iPhone on Hong Kong education sites only, excluding the word 'repair'.
ex.a: iPhone site:edu.hk -repair (optionally "Apple iPhone" for exact phrase).
ex.az: iPhone site:edu.hk -repair

cards.en:
Anyone with an Internet connection can access and publish information, so some information may be inaccurate, out of date, incomplete or incorrect due to lack of quality control. Before using or spreading it, evaluate its reliability, credibility and timeliness.
CriterionQuestionsHow to check
ReliabilityConsistent with other sources? Sources clearly cited?Verify with other sources; check broken links
CredibilityHow qualified is the provider?Check the domain (.gov, .edu, .org); search for information on the author
TimelinessUp to date for your needs? Newer update?Check the publish date; broken links; frequency of updates
Tools: reverse image search, Google's Fact Check label.
cards.zh:
任何人都可发布，资讯可能不准、过时、不完整。使用或转发前要评估三方面：
Reliability 可靠性：与其他来源一致吗？→ 与其他来源核对、检查失效连结。
Credibility 可信性：作者有资格吗？→ 查域名（.gov/.edu/.org）、查作者背景。
Timeliness 时效性：够新吗？→ 查发布日期、更新频率。
工具：以图搜图、Fact Check 标签。

ex.q: A 2010 search result says 'over 500 species of plants' in the Zoological and Botanical Gardens. What should Eva do before using it?
ex.a: Check timeliness – the information is old (2010), so verify the latest figure on the official website (.gov.hk) and compare with other credible sources before using it.
ex.az: 资料是 2010 年的，要到官方网站核实最新数字，并与其他可信来源比较。

cards.en:
Spreading or using misinformation or fake news can cause unnecessary panic, reputational damage, monetary loss and distrust in media; others may also make wrong decisions.
Examples: in 2011, rumours that Japan's nuclear leak polluted sea salt (and that iodised salt protects from radiation) led to panic buying of salt in Hong Kong. Fake Hongkong Post messages with links to phishing websites asked people to pay delivery fees – a combination of misinformation and fraud.

Good practice: confirm the primary source, compare with official websites, do not forward unverified messages, use fact-checking services.
cards.zh:
传播假资讯会造成不必要恐慌、名誉受损、金钱损失、不信任媒体，令他人作出错误决定。
例：2011 年日本核事故谣言引发香港抢购盐；假香港邮政讯息连到钓鱼网站要求付运费。
好习惯：找第一手来源、对照官方网站、不转发未核实讯息。

ex.q: Amy receives a forwarded message saying all tutorial classes are cancelled tomorrow due to a typhoon. What should she do?
ex.a: Before deciding, confirm the primary source (ask who issued it), compare with official announcements (Hong Kong Observatory/tutorial centre website). She should not forward it, since others may make wrong decisions based on false information.
ex.az: 先找原始来源、对照天文台或补习社官方公布；未核实不要转发。

cards.t: Internet vs library as information sources
cards.tz: 互联网与图书馆作资料来源
cards.en:
Advantages of the Internet: search anywhere and anytime with Internet access; information is more likely to be up to date than printed books; fast keyword search; multimedia; compare many sources quickly.
Common wrong beliefs: online information is NOT automatically free to use (it is still copyrighted), and anyone – not only experts – can publish online, so it is not automatically credible.
Advantages of library/books: edited and checked by publishers; stable content.
cards.zh:
Internet 好处：随时随地搜寻、较新、关键字搜寻快、多媒体、可快速比较。
常见错误：网上资讯不是都免费任用（仍有版权）；任何人都可发布，不一定可信。
图书馆／书本：经出版者编辑审核、内容稳定。

ex.q: Which are advantages of the Internet over a library? (1) access anytime (2) more up to date (3) not copyrighted (4) only experts publish
ex.a: (1) and (2) only. (3) is wrong – online content is still copyrighted; (4) is wrong – anyone can publish.

cards.en:
With faster Internet, most websites include text, graphics, animation, video and audio. Multimedia can deliver ideas more easily, attract users to stay longer, and support users with different learning styles and disabilities (e.g. audio for the visually impaired, captions for the hearing impaired).

Lossless compression offers the best quality but uses much more transmission data and slows down the loading time. Therefore web designers choose suitable file formats to reduce file size for faster transmission. Formats differ in supported colour depth, compression method (lossy/lossless), transparency, animation and browser compatibility.
cards.zh:
网站常含文字、图像、动画、影片、声音。多媒体能更易传达意念、吸引用户停留，并照顾不同学习风格和残障人士。
无损压缩画质最好，但数据量大、载入慢，所以要选合适格式缩小文件、加快传输。格式在色彩深度、压缩方法（有损／无损）、透明、动画、兼容性方面不同。

ex.q: Carol's phone data was used up quickly early in the billing cycle. Suggest possible reasons.
ex.a: Automatic photo backups over cellular network; browsing social media with many videos/images; watching high-quality video streams; listening to lossless music online.
ex.az: 自动用流动数据备份相片、看多影片的社交网站、高清串流、无损音乐。

cards.en:
• JPG – lossy, fairly small, most compatible; photos on social media and news. No transparency.
  • PNG – lossless, fairly large; supports transparent background; good for screenshots, images with text, icons.
  • GIF – max 256 colours, supports simple animation and transparency; memes.
  • APNG – lossless animated images, e.g. stickers.
  • WebP – smaller size with the same visible quality; supports lossy/lossless, transparency, animation; supported by latest browsers.
  • SVG – vector graphics; sharp at any resolution; icons, logos.
  • AVIF – new, open-source; even smaller with same quality; less support.
SWF (Flash vector) is obsolete – Flash Player support ended at the end of 2020.
cards.zh:
JPG：有损、细、兼容最好，适合相片；不支援透明。
PNG：无损、较大，支援透明背景，适合截图、带文字图片。
GIF：最多 256 色，支援简单动画。
APNG：无损动画（贴图）。
WebP：同画质更细，支援透明及动画，新浏览器支援。
SVG：向量图，任何解像度都清晰，适合 icon、logo。
AVIF：新、开源、更细，支援较少。SWF 已于 2020 年底淘汰。

ex.q: Eva posts software screenshots with text on the option bars to her blog. Which format is best?
ex.a: PNG – lossless compression keeps text sharp without the blurry artefacts of lossy JPG; screenshots have flat colours so PNG files stay reasonably small.
ex.az: PNG：无损，文字清晰；JPG 有损会令文字模糊。

cards.en:
Raster (bitmap) images (JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP, BMP) store a grid of pixels. Enlarging them beyond their resolution causes pixelation/blurring. File size grows with resolution and colour depth. Best for photos with complex colours.

Vector images (SVG; formerly SWF) store shapes as mathematical descriptions (lines, curves, fills). They can be scaled to any size without losing quality, usually have small file sizes for simple graphics, and are editable. Best for icons, logos, illustrations; not suitable for photographs.

For an icon to look sharp on all devices with different display resolutions, use SVG.
cards.zh:
点阵图（JPG、PNG、GIF、WebP、BMP）由像素组成，放大会出现锯齿／模糊；解像度高文件大；适合相片。
向量图（SVG）以数学描述形状，放大不失真，简单图形文件细，易编辑；适合 icon、logo，不适合相片。
要在不同解像度装置都清晰 → 用 SVG。

ex.q: A phone icon is saved as PNG, WebP, SVG and JPG. Which keeps it sharp on all screens, and which cannot have a transparent background?
ex.a: SVG keeps it sharp at any resolution because it is vector. JPG cannot store a transparent background.
ex.az: SVG 永远清晰；JPG 不支援透明。

cards.en:
Audio is used in music streaming, online dictionaries, Internet radio, and sound effects for HTML games and buttons. It is hard to hear the difference between lossy and lossless audio, so lossy compressed audio is usually enough for normal listening.
  • MP3 – lossy, most compatible, relatively small.
  • AAC – lossy, better sound quality at lower bitrate than MP3; used for streaming and video soundtracks (YouTube Music).
  • OGG (Vorbis) – lossy, open-source; streaming (e.g. Spotify).
  • FLAC / ALAC – lossless compression, large; high-quality lossless music streaming (ALAC: Apple, few supported).
  • WAV – usually uncompressed, very large; original recordings for editing/compression.
Bitrate (kbps) = amount of data per second of audio: higher bitrate → better quality, bigger file.
cards.zh:
音频用于音乐串流、网上字典发音、网上电台、网页游戏音效。一般人难分辨有损与无损，普通聆听用有损已足够。
MP3：有损、兼容最好。AAC：有损，较低 bitrate 下音质更好，常用于串流。OGG：有损、开源。FLAC/ALAC：无损、大，高质串流。WAV：通常无压缩、非常大，原始档。
Bitrate（kbps）= 每秒音频的数据量；越高音质越好、文件越大。

ex.q: George uploads a song cover to platforms that will re-encode it into several formats. Which is best to upload: AAC/128kbps, MP3/256kbps, FLAC/1184kbps, OGG/96kbps? Which should be offered to slow-Internet users?
ex.a: Upload FLAC/1184kbps – lossless, highest quality, so later re-encoding starts from the best source. For slow connections offer a low-bitrate lossy format such as OGG/96kbps or AAC/128kbps.
ex.az: 上传 FLAC（无损最高质）；慢网用户提供 OGG 96kbps 等低 bitrate。

cards.en:
Video files are large, requiring higher Internet bandwidth and increasing loading time, so choose proper formats and codecs to keep quality with smooth playback; smaller files also save data transmission cost.
Codec = encoding and decoding scheme (compresses and decompresses video).
  • MP4 (usually H.264/H.265 codec) – most compatible, good quality and size.
  • WebM (VP9/AV1 codec) – open-source, smaller than H.264 with similar quality, used for streaming; fewer devices supported; needs advanced hardware/software.
  • AV1 – new open-source codec with higher compression efficiency (Google, Netflix, Amazon…).
  • AVI – old, large files; not suitable for the web.
  • FLV – obsolete (Flash ended 2020).
Sites often provide both WebM and MP4: browsers that don't support WebM can fall back to MP4.
cards.zh:
影片大，需较高带宽、载入慢，所以要选合适格式和 codec，兼顾画质与流畅，并节省传输成本。
Codec = 编码及解码方案。
MP4（H.264）：兼容最好。WebM（VP9/AV1）：开源、比 H.264 细，支援较少。AV1：新开源高压缩率 codec。AVI：大，不宜网页。FLV 已淘汰。
网站常同时提供 WebM 和 MP4，不支援 WebM 的浏览器可退回用 MP4。

ex.q: Carol uploads her video in AVI to keep original quality. Give two problems.
ex.a: AVI files are very large, so users with low bandwidth suffer long loading time; it uses more storage and data transmission cost; browsers may not play AVI directly. (Note: 'most OSes cannot play AVI' is false.)
ex.az: AVI 文件大：低带宽用户载入慢、耗流量和空间；浏览器未必能直接播放。

cards.en:
Sometimes browsers cannot view or play some media files because they lack support for the format, especially new or patented codecs. A plug-in, also known as an add-on or extension, is a program that enables browsers or operating systems to support extra formats, codecs or functionality. If a browser does not support a format (e.g. AVIF), it may download the file instead of displaying it.

Built-in media support varies from browser to browser. Installed plug-ins can be viewed in browser settings. Keep plug-ins and browsers up-to-date to fix security vulnerabilities and ensure a better user experience; only install plug-ins from trusted sources.
cards.zh:
浏览器缺少某格式（特别是新或专利 codec）就无法显示。插件（add-on / extension）是让浏览器或作业系统支援额外格式、codec 或功能的程式。不支援时（如 AVIF）浏览器可能改为下载文件。
各浏览器内建支援不同。要保持插件和浏览器更新以修补保安漏洞；只装可信插件。

ex.q: A user's browser downloads an .avif image instead of showing it. Explain and suggest a fix.
ex.a: The browser does not support the AVIF format/codec. Update the browser to a version that supports AVIF, install a plug-in/extension to decode it, or open the file with an image viewer/media application that supports it.
ex.az: 浏览器不支援 AVIF；更新浏览器、装插件，或用支援的软件开启。

cards.en:
Besides opening online resources in a browser, you can download media files and open them offline. A media player is software designed for the playback of audio and video files (e.g. Windows Media Player, Groove Music, VLC, QuickTime). When a browser fails to open a format and no plug-in is available, try a media player.

Like browsers, media players fail to play content if the supporting codecs are missing, so update the player or install the codec pack. Remember: a file extension (container) like .mp4 can hold different codecs; a player needs the right codec, not just the right extension.
cards.zh:
除了在浏览器开启，也可下载后离线播放。媒体播放器是专门播放音频及影片的软件（Windows Media Player、VLC）。浏览器打不开又没插件时，可试用播放器。
同样地，缺少相应 codec 就播放失败，要更新播放器或安装 codec。注意：同一扩展名（如 .mp4）内可用不同 codec。

ex.q: A downloaded .mkv video shows sound but no picture in a media player. Explain.
ex.a: The player has the audio codec but lacks the video codec used in the file, so it cannot decode the video stream. Install the missing codec or use a player that supports it (e.g. VLC).
ex.az: 播放器缺少该影片的视频 codec，只能解码声音；安装 codec 或换播放器。

cards.en:
If you download a video, you must wait for the whole file before watching. Streaming is a technology used for delivering media over the Internet with a continuous flow of data. Users can play and download the media simultaneously, so the waiting time is shortened.

On the client side, the player keeps a buffer: data already played (removed after playing) | current playback position | buffer (loaded media data) | data not yet loaded. The player starts after enough data is buffered and keeps downloading the remaining content from the streaming server. If the download rate is slower than the playback rate, the buffer empties and playback pauses (buffering).

Live stream = streaming real-time events (sports, games, live shopping).
cards.zh:
下载要等整个文件完成才能看。串流是以连续数据流经 Internet 传送媒体的技术，用户可一边下载一边播放，等候时间缩短。
用户端有缓冲区 buffer：已播放（播完移除）│播放位置│已载入的缓冲│未载入。缓冲足够后开始播放，并继续从串流伺服器下载。若下载速度慢于播放速度，缓冲用完便暂停（buffering）。
直播 live stream：实时串流（体育、游戏、直播购物）。

ex.q: A 4 Mbps video is streamed on a 3 Mbps connection. What happens?
ex.a: Data arrives at 3 Mb per second but playback consumes 4 Mb per second, so the buffer drains by 1 Mb each second; after the initial buffer runs out, playback pauses to buffer (or the player lowers the quality with adaptive streaming).
ex.az: 下载 3 Mbps 少于播放 4 Mbps，缓冲每秒减少 1 Mb，用完就卡顿（或自动降画质）。

cards.en:
StreamingDownloading
StartPlay in real time without downloading the entire fileWait for whole file
StorageDoes not save the entire file, saves storage spaceUses local storage
OfflineNo offline playbackCan play offline
QualityBandwidth limits quality / smoothnessFull quality after download
CopyrightHarder to copyEasy to copy
Streaming is ideal for live events and on-demand video; downloading suits poor/no connections.
cards.zh:
串流：不用下载整个文件就能实时播放、省储存空间、较难复制；但不能离线、画质与流畅度受带宽限制。
下载：要等完、占空间，但可离线、画质完整。

ex.q: A school considers streaming lesson videos instead of letting students download them. Give one advantage and one disadvantage.
ex.a: Advantage: videos play in real time without waiting / no storage needed on students' devices. Disadvantage: no offline playback, so students with a poor connection suffer lag or low quality.
ex.az: 好处：即时播放、省空间。坏处：不能离线，网差学生会卡。

cards.t: Voice mail: voice calls and voice messages
cards.tz: 话音邮件：语音通话与语音讯息
cards.en:
IM apps and social media enable voice calls and voice messages.
  • Voice calls enable real-time communication like phone calls, using VoIP (Voice over Internet Protocol); some services let users dial ordinary phone numbers.
  • Voice messaging allows users to deliver and receive messages anytime as an alternative to text messages. The audio is split and compressed into smaller files so that users hardly wait.
Voice calls need both parties online at the same time; voice messages are asynchronous and can be replayed.
cards.zh:
IM 与社交媒体有语音通话和语音讯息。
语音通话：像电话般实时沟通，用 VoIP。
语音讯息：随时发送和接收，代替文字讯息；音频被分割压缩成小文件。
通话要双方同时在线；讯息是非同步的，可重听。

ex.q: Why may a busy student prefer a voice message to a voice call with a teacher?
ex.a: Voice messages are asynchronous: the teacher can listen and reply anytime, they need not be online at the same time, and the message can be replayed.
ex.az: 语音讯息不用双方同时在线，可随时听和回覆，可重播。

cards.en:
Video conferencing allows real-time face-to-face meetings over the Internet with screen sharing, chat and recording (Zoom, Teams). Webcasting is broadcasting live or pre-recorded audio or video over the Internet (Internet radio/TV, live-stream shopping).
Video conferencingWebcasting
Listeners/viewersHundreds or relatively smallUnlimited or fairly large
MediaReal-timeReal-time or pre-recorded
CommunicationTwo-way, more interactionMainly one-way; live comments can be enabled
PrivacySuitable for private eventsSuitable for public events
cards.zh:
视像会议：实时面对面会议，可分享画面、聊天、录影。网上广播 webcasting：经 Internet 广播直播或预录影音。
人数：会议数百或较少；广播无限或大量。
沟通：会议双向、多互动；广播主要单向，可开留言。
私隐：会议适合私人活动；广播适合公开活动。

ex.q: A school wants to show its Christmas talent show to all parents and the public. Video conferencing or webcasting?
ex.a: Webcasting: the audience is large/unlimited, communication is mainly one-way, and it is a public event; it can be live or pre-recorded. An existing webcasting platform saves development cost and viewers only need a browser.
ex.az: Webcasting：观众多、单向、公开活动。

cards.tz: 影响串流质素的技术因素
cards.en:
The better the quality, the larger the file size. Transmitting large files with low bandwidth may result in latency and pixelisation. Factors:
  • Media format / codec – compressed formats (MP4, AAC) recommended.
  • Bitrate – data per second; higher bitrate = better quality but needs more bandwidth.
  • Resolution – video frame size (144p … 1080p, 4K); higher = sharper but more data.
  • Frame rate – frames per second; higher = smoother motion but more data.
  • Network bandwidth of server and user; Internet connection stability – insufficient buffer causes pauses.
Streaming sites use adaptive streaming: deliver the best quality based on the user's network. Data size = bitrate × time; e.g. 5 Mbps × 60 s = 300 Mb = 37.5 MB.
cards.zh:
质素越好文件越大，低带宽会出现延迟和画面马赛克（pixelisation）。因素：格式／codec、bitrate（每秒数据量）、解像度、帧率、带宽、连线稳定性。
串流网站用 adaptive streaming，按网速给最佳画质。
计算：数据量 = bitrate × 时间；5 Mbps × 60 s = 300 Mb = 37.5 MB（÷8）。

ex.q: Calculate the data used by streaming a 2-hour movie at 5 Mbps (1 MB = 8 Mb, 1 GB = 1000 MB).

cards.tz: 低延迟模式与直播问题
cards.en:
Live-streaming platforms offer latency mode settings. Low latency: viewers see the stream nearly in real time, best when the broadcaster wants to reply to viewers' comments (e.g. gaming streams), but a smaller buffer means playback is more likely to stall on an unstable network. Normal latency: a larger buffer gives smoother playback with higher delay.

When starting a live stream, consider: upload bandwidth, bitrate, formats and codecs, video resolution, platform readiness. Platforms may cap resolution (e.g. 1440p) for low-latency mode because high-resolution streaming needs more bandwidth for buffering and is more likely to have high latency.
